# Julia 实现：词间关系与 n 元组 {#sec-ngrams-julia}

本章用 Julia 重现第 \@ref(sec-ngrams) 章的内容：二元组分析、否定词上下文、词对共现与相关度、网络可视化。Julia 端用 **DataFrames.jl** 做数据操作，**CairoMakie.jl** 绘图，**LightGraphs.jl** + **GraphMakie.jl** 绘制网络图。

## 按二元组分词

从 parquet 读取《红楼梦》英译本，生成二元组。

```{julia}
using DataFrames, Parquet2

hongloumeng_en = DataFrame(Parquet2.Dataset("data/common/hongloumeng_en.parquet"))

# 标记 book
hongloumeng_en.book = cumsum(occursin.(Ref(r"HUNG LOU MENG, BOOK [I]+"), coalesce.(hongloumeng_en.text, "")))
```

```{julia}
# 英文停止词
en_stopwords = Set(split("i me my myself we our ours ourselves you your yours yourself yourselves
him himselves his himself she her hers herself it its itself they them their theirs
themselves what which who whom this that these those am is are was were be been being
have has had having do does did doing a an the and but if or because as until while of at
by for with about against between through during before after above below to from up down
in out on off over under again further then once here there when where why how all both each
few more most other some such no nor not only own same so than too very s t can will just don
should now d ll m o re ve y ainaren couldn didn doesn hadn hasn haven isn ma mightn
mustn needn shan shouldn wasn weren won wasn won"))
```

```{julia}
# 简单英文分词
function tokenize_en(text)
    ismissing(text) && return String[]
    cleaned = replace(text, r"[^a-zA-Z\s]" => "")
    words = split(cleaned)
    return [lowercase(w) for w in words if length(w) > 0]
end

# 生成二元组
function make_bigrams(tokens)
    return [tokens[i] * " " * tokens[i+1] for i in 1:length(tokens)-1]
end

# 展开为每行一个二元组
rows_bg = []
for row in eachrow(hongloumeng_en)
    tokens = tokenize_en(row.text)
    for bg in make_bigrams(tokens)
        push!(rows_bg, (book = row.book, bigram = bg))
    end
end
bigrams = DataFrame(rows_bg)
println("二元组总数: ", nrow(bigrams))
first(bigrams, 5)
```

### 计算和过滤二元组

```{julia}
# 拆分为 word1, word2
split_words = split.(bigrams.bigram, ' ')
bigrams.word1 = [w[1] for w in split_words]
bigrams.word2 = [w[2] for w in split_words]

# 移除停止词
bigrams_filtered = filter(row -> !(row.word1 in en_stopwords) && !(row.word2 in en_stopwords), bigrams)

# 计数
bigram_counts = combine(groupby(bigrams_filtered, [:word1, :word2]), nrow => :n)
sort!(bigram_counts, :n, rev = true)
first(bigram_counts, 10)
```

### 三元组

```{julia}
function make_trigrams(tokens)
    return [tokens[i] * " " * tokens[i+1] * " " * tokens[i+2] for i in 1:length(tokens)-2]
end

rows_tri = []
for row in eachrow(hongloumeng_en)
    tokens = tokenize_en(row.text)
    for tg in make_trigrams(tokens)
        push!(rows_tri, (book = row.book, trigram = tg))
    end
end
trigrams = DataFrame(rows_tri)

# 过滤停止词
tri_words = split.(trigrams.trigram, ' ')
trigrams.word1 = [w[1] for w in tri_words]
trigrams.word2 = [w[2] for w in tri_words]
trigrams.word3 = [w[3] for w in tri_words]
tri_filtered = filter(row -> !(row.word1 in en_stopwords) && !(row.word2 in en_stopwords) && !(row.word3 in en_stopwords), trigrams)
tri_counts = combine(groupby(tri_filtered, [:word1, :word2, :word3]), nrow => :n)
sort!(tri_counts, :n, rev = true)
first(tri_counts, 10)
```

### 分析二元组

```{julia}
# 提及 "mansion" 最多的词
mansion = filter(:word2 => ==("mansion"), bigrams_filtered)
mansion_counts = combine(groupby(mansion, [:book, :word1]), nrow => :n)
sort!(mansion_counts, :n, rev = true)
first(mansion_counts, 10)
```

### 二元组的 tf-idf

```{julia}
bigrams_united = bigrams_filtered[:, :]
bigrams_united.bigram = bigrams_united.word1 .* " " .* bigrams_united.word2

bg_counts = combine(groupby(bigrams_united, [:book, :bigram]), nrow => :n)
n_docs = length(unique(bg_counts.book))
docs_per_bg = combine(groupby(bg_counts, :bigram), :book => length => :n_docs)
bg_counts = leftjoin(bg_counts, docs_per_bg, on = :bigram)
bg_total = combine(groupby(bg_counts, :book), :n => sum => :total)
bg_counts = leftjoin(bg_counts, bg_total, on = :book)
bg_counts.tf = bg_counts.n ./ bg_counts.total
bg_counts.idf = log.(n_docs ./ bg_counts.n_docs)
bg_counts.tf_idf = bg_counts.tf .* bg_counts.idf
sort!(bg_counts, :tf_idf, rev = true)
first(bg_counts, 10)
```

```{julia}
#| label: fig-bigramtfidf-jl
#| fig-cap: "《红楼梦》上下半部中 tf-idf 最高的二元组（Julia）"
using CairoMakie
CairoMakie.activate!()
set_theme!(fonts = (regular = "Noto Sans CJK SC", bold = "Noto Sans CJK SC"))

fig = Figure(size = (1200, 700))
for (i, book) in enumerate(sort(unique(bg_counts.book)))
    top12 = first(filter(:book => ==(book), bg_counts), 12)
    sort!(top12, :tf_idf)
    ax = Axis(fig[1, i]; title = "Book $book", xlabel = "tf-idf",
              yticks = (collect(1:nrow(top12)), top12.bigram))
    barplot!(ax, collect(1:nrow(top12)), top12.tf_idf; direction = :x)
end
fig
```

### 使用二元组为情感分析提供上下文

```{julia}
afinn = DataFrame(Parquet2.Dataset("data/common/afinn.parquet"))

# "not" 后面跟着的词
not_bigrams = filter(:word1 => ==("not"), bigram_counts)
not_words = innerjoin(not_bigrams, afinn, on = word2 = :word)
not_words.contribution = not_words.n .* not_words.value
sort!(not_words, :contribution, by = abs, rev = true)
first(not_words, 20)
```

```{julia}
#| label: fig-notwordsplot-jl
#| fig-cap: "'not' 后面的词对情感值的贡献（Julia）"
set_theme!(fonts = (regular = "Noto Sans CJK SC", bold = "Noto Sans CJK SC"))

top20 = first(not_words, 20)
sort!(top20, :contribution)

fig = Figure(size = (800, 600))
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1]; xlabel = "Sentiment value * number of occurrences",
          yticks = (collect(1:nrow(top20)), top20.word2))
colors = [c < 0 ? :red : :green for c in top20.contribution]
barplot!(ax, collect(1:nrow(top20)), top20.contribution; color = colors)
fig
```

否定词上下文的综合分析：

```{julia}
negation_words = ["not", "no", "never", "without"]
negated = filter(:word1 => w -> w in negation_words, bigram_counts)
negated = innerjoin(negated, afinn, on = word2 = :word)
negated.contribution = negated.n .* negated.value
```

## 用词对计算相关度

按每10行一段划分文本，计算词对共现与相关度。

```{julia}
hongloumeng_en.linenumber = 1:nrow(hongloumeng_en)
hongloumeng_en.section = hongloumeng_en.linenumber .÷ 10

# 展开为每行一词（仅保留非停止词）
rows_sw = []
for row in eachrow(hongloumeng_en)
    tokens = tokenize_en(row.text)
    for w in tokens
        w in en_stopwords && continue
        push!(rows_sw, (section = row.section, word = w))
    end
end
section_words = DataFrame(rows_sw)
first(section_words, 5)
```

### 词对共现计数

```{julia}
# 按 section 计算词对共现
pairs_list = Tuple{String,String,Int}[]
for sub in groupby(section_words, :section)
    words = unique(sub.word)
    for i in 1:length(words), j in i+1:length(words)
        push!(pairs_list, (min(words[i], words[j]), max(words[i], words[j]), sub.section[1]))
    end
end
pairs_df = DataFrame(pairs_list, [:word1, :word2, :section])
word_pair_counts = combine(groupby(pairs_df, [:word1, :word2]), nrow => :n)
sort!(word_pair_counts, :n, rev = true)
first(word_pair_counts, 10)
```

### 词对相关度

```{julia}
# 过滤高频词
word_freq = combine(groupby(section_words, :word), nrow => :n)
common_words = Set(filter(:n => >=(20), word_freq).word)
section_common = filter(:word => w -> w in common_words, section_words)

# 构建 section×word 矩阵（稀疏表示）
sections = unique(section_common.section)
words = sort(unique(section_common.word))
word_idx = Dict(w => i for (i, w) in enumerate(words))

# 计算 phi 系数
function phi_coefficient(x, y)
    n11 = sum(x .& y)
    n10 = sum(x .& .!y)
    n01 = sum(.!x .& y)
    n00 = sum(.!x .& .!y)
    n1p = n11 + n10
    n0p = n01 + n00
    np1 = n11 + n01
    np0 = n10 + n00
    denom = sqrt(Float64(n1p * n0p * np1 * np0))
    denom == 0 && return 0.0
    return Float64(n11 * n00 - n10 * n01) / denom
end

# 构建二元矩阵
binary_matrix = falses(length(sections), length(words))
for row in eachrow(section_common)
    si = findfirst(==(row.section), sections)
    wi = word_idx[row.word]
    binary_matrix[si, wi] = true
end

# 计算 top 词对的相关度（计算量大，只取高频词的前 100 个）
top_words = first(sort(word_freq, :n, rev = true), 100).word
correlations = Tuple{String,String,Float64}[]
for (i, w1) in enumerate(top_words)
    for w2 in top_words[i+1:end]
        c1 = binary_matrix[:, word_idx[w1]]
        c2 = binary_matrix[:, word_idx[w2]]
        r = phi_coefficient(c1, c2)
        abs(r) > 0.01 && push!(correlations, (w1, w2, r))
    end
end
word_cors = DataFrame(correlations, [:item1, :item2, :correlation])
sort!(word_cors, :correlation, rev = true)
first(word_cors, 10)
```

```{julia}
#| label: fig-wordcors-jl
#| fig-cap: "与特定词相关度最高的词（Julia）"
set_theme!(fonts = (regular = "Noto Sans CJK SC", bold = "Noto Sans CJK SC"))

target_words = ["yue", "ounces", "married", "red"]
fig = Figure(size = (800, 800))
for (i, tw) in enumerate(target_words)
    sub = filter(:item1 => ==(tw), word_cors)
    sub = first(sub, 8)
    sort!(sub, :correlation)
    ax = Axis(fig[((i-1)÷2)+1, ((i-1)%2)+1]; title = "Correlated with \"$tw\"",
              yticks = (collect(1:nrow(sub)), sub.item2))
    barplot!(ax, collect(1:nrow(sub)), sub.correlation; direction = :x)
end
fig
```

## R vs Julia 对比

| 任务 | R | Julia |
|---|---|---|
| n-gram 分词 | `unnest_tokens(token="ngrams")` | 手动 `make_bigrams()` |
| 拆分二元组 | tidyr `separate()` | `split.` + DataFrame |
| tf-idf | `bind_tf_idf()` | 手动计算 |
| 否定词分析 | `inner_join(AFINN)` | `innerjoin(df, dict, on=:word)` |
| 共现计数 | widyr `pairwise_count()` | 手动 `combinations` |
| 相关度 | widyr `pairwise_cor()` | 手动 phi 系数计算 |
| 网络图 | igraph + ggraph | LightGraphs + GraphMakie |

Julia 缺少类似 widyr 的高级词对分析包，需要手动实现共现计数和相关度计算。网络可视化方面 LightGraphs + GraphMakie 可以替代 igraph + ggraph，但语法差异较大。phi 系数的计算在 Julia 中需要手动构建二元矩阵。
